name: session-facts
description: Adds the exact local time and context fill to every prompt, for the model only, shows the session's budgets (context, plan usage, prompt cache) in a row above the prompt, and compacts a big conversation left idle before its prompt cache goes cold, which the engine no longer does itself.

planWarnAt.title: Warn on plan usage at (%)
planWarnAt.description: A plan window at or above this share turns yellow and shows when it resets. It turns red at usage-guard's wrap-up level.

cacheWarnMinutes.title: Warn before the cache goes cold (minutes)
cacheWarnMinutes.description: The prompt-cache countdown shows once this few minutes are left. 0 shows it only once the cache is cold.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Used only until the lifetime is read from the session transcript after each reply (60 on a plan within its included usage, 5 past it or on an API key), or when the transcript cannot be read. Then a miss between 5 minutes and this lifetime switches the countdown to 5 minutes until a warm request outlives them.

idleCompact.title: Compact an idle conversation
idleCompact.description: Since 2.1.293 the engine no longer compacts a big conversation left idle before its prompt cache goes cold. With this on, the mod does it once per reply, a minute after the engine's own time, unless auto-compact is off (in /config, DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT or DISABLE_COMPACT).
